name: Hobgoblin Warrior

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points some- where in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hezrou. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Leap
actions.text: The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement. Hill Giant Hill Giant
